item: Mars surface mid-latitude cycle and dark-period inputs
notes: Stored as cycle_period_hr, eclipse_fraction and dark_period_hr. dark_period_hr is the cycle multiplied by the fraction.

value: NASA Mars Fact Sheet: Mars mass, radius and rotation; Appelbaum & Flood, NASA TM-102299: Mars surface insolation and dust caveat
notes: Neither citation-map entry identifies the mid-latitude illumination fraction.

location_in_source: Orbital parameters table, Length of day
notes: Supports the row cycle_period_hr rounded to 24.66 h; it does not supply a surface day/night fraction.

value: 25-hour cycle; approximately 50 percent of the time spent under illumination
location_in_source: PDF p. 2, Reduced Solar Energy Availability
notes: NASA 2023 Moon to Mars Architecture Concept Review white paper; NTRS 20230015763.
The stored dark period is the arithmetic product of cycle_period_hr and eclipse_fraction.
